modifications: Extracted AGSL strings into GlassShaders.kt; expanded Kotlin string interpolation. Existing SunnyTV GraphicsLayer pipeline, fixed light direction, native cached blur, original D-pad layout, flat child buttons. In 0.3.5, bloom output uses premultiplied coverage and SrcOver instead of opaque-alpha additive blending, preserving translucent offscreen composition. Page buttons sample per-page registered artwork; focus adjusts opacity only.

blurMapping.note: Platform separable blur; sampling kernel is not copied wholesale. No claim of pixel-identical rendering across GPUs.
